reason: The hypothesis directly restates the dual-mechanism strategy, material system, and quantitative outcomes from P3 and P15, which already report the design, testing, and results for a NiCoCrAl-type MPEA with lamellar microstructure, Y/Hf doping, and lattice-distortion-suppressed diffusion. The proposed intervention, mechanism, and predicted outcome are taken almost verbatim from that single body of work, with only a minor adjustment in temperature range (800–1100°C vs. 1200°C) and the addition of a falsification test that is a standard experimental validation of the same claims.
copied_elements: rapid formation of continuous, adherent Al2O3 scale
refined lamellar eutectic microstructure promoting selective Al oxidation
reactive element (Y) segregation anchoring oxide scale
lattice distortion increasing vacancy formation energy and suppressing Al diffusion
lower TGO growth rate (~50-60% reduction) vs. MCrAlY
